description: Lists announcements (banner notices shown on top of the public status page): title, body, type/severity, optional display window (`started_at`/`ended_at`) and optional link. Includes scheduled, active and ended entries — filter by time on the client side. `is_disabled_by_plan: true` means the current plan has no announcements: the entry is not shown on the page, but is kept and shows again after an upgrade.
name: status_page_announcement_list
title: List announcements for a status page
